title: Te Mano tini i Ngaro
intro: Kei mua koe i ngā haruru o tētahi hapori kua tuhia nei te kōrero ki ngā ngaru. I rongo ēnei wairua i tētahi karanga, i whiriwhiri i te whakakeke, ā, i tūtaki ki tētahi hua i huri ai te ao. Ko wai rātou, ā, i pēhea rā tō rātou ao?
clues: I noho tātou i ngā rā o mua, ā, i tae mai tētahi karere ki a tātou i roto i a tātou anō.
E rima ngā whakapakoko i karakia mātou, ā, kāore mātou i pai ki te whakarērea i a rātou.
I tawai mātou ki te karere, i whakapae hoki i a ia mō te he.
I tohe mātou kia whiua ia mēnā he pono tana kōrero.
I kite mātou i te rangi e ringihia ana te ua, me te whenua e pupu mai ana i ngā puna.
I piki mātou ki ngā wāhi teitei hei mawhiti, engari i mau mātou i ngā ngaru.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I toremi mātou i roto i te waipuke nui
I whakangaromia mātou e te awhiowhio
I mate mātou i te pahūtanga nui
I horomia mātou e te whenua
I whiua mātou ki ngā kōhatu mai i te rangi
trial.answer: I toremi mātou i roto i te waipuke nui

outcome.label: Hua
options: I mate katoa tātou engari ko te hunga whakapono i a Noa
I waiho mātou hei ururua mā ngā kaihaerere
I homai he wā okiokinga ki a mātou
outcome.answer: I mate katoa tātou engari ko te hunga whakapono i a Noa

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
